According to Chinese criminal law, illegally hunting wild animals that are protected by the state (including three-haves animals) in a hunting ban area, during a hunting ban period, or using prohibited tools/methods, if the circumstances are serious, constitutes the crime of illegal hunting (非法狩猎罪).
Capturing 70 frogs qualifies as "serious circumstances" (usually 20+ is the threshold for "three-haves" animals in many provinces, or 50+ nationally).
